ai_review.review: The reviewer highlights an unusual placement of “Truckin” as the first‑set closer, noting Jerry’s aggressive, full‑frontal guitar attack and a distinctive, if slightly odd, vocal outro from Bob. The performance also includes a noteworthy exploration in “Playin’ in the Band,” making this show stand out despite the lack of comments on recording fidelity.
